unique_cloners.method: unique cloners of the first saved API window plus the sum of daily unique cloners for each later UTC date; people active on several periods are counted once per period, so this is an upper bound on distinct people
unique_cloners.unobserved_daily_uniques: Dates before 2026-11-02 were saved only as one window aggregate; daily uniques for them are unavailable.
